source: Original option illustrations inspired only by the horn shapes in the four images supplied by the user. Character identities, clothing and signatures were not copied.

options.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create an ORIGINAL square horn-style option illustration for a fantasy RPG character creation selector. Image 1 is a reference ONLY for the HORN SHAPE: Very tall elegant narrow horns, open SINUOUS S curves, rising from upper lateral temples, bowing outward then pointing upward and subtly inward, faceted dark ridges. Image 2 defines ONLY the neutral mannequin presentation, lighting and painterly semi-realistic inventory rendering. Show a generic FEATURELESS bald charcoal-gray mannequin head and short neck, frontal symmetrical view, with exactly TWO matching horns inspired by the horn shape in image 1. Do not copy the character, face, hair, ears, clothing, pose, tattoos, jewelry, magic, text or signatures of image 1. The mannequin has no facial features and no ears. Horn roots must attach at anatomically equivalent positions on the left and right upper sides of the skull, at the same height and same distance back from the forehead. No horn centered on the forehead or higher than its mate. A single unbranched pointed tip per horn. The subject is the horns; their silhouette must visibly match the specified shape and be easy to distinguish as a thumbnail. Entire tips inside frame with generous margins, head centered. Plain dark charcoal background #171512, no text, frames, symbols, torso, extra horns or branch tips.
